output.text: The robotics workshop filled the community hall with the hum of small motors and the smell of solder. Assume that Noor is the head judge. Teams arrived early to set up their stations, arranging tools and spare parts across long tables. Kira arrived a few minutes after Ivo, both carrying boxes of gears wrapped in cloth. Leo drove the minibus. Nell had spent the previous night charging batteries and testing sensors, determined to be ready for the opening challenge. The morning session began with a maze navigation task, where each team guided a small robot through a winding course. Nell finished ahead of Ivo. Spectators clapped as each robot cleared the checkpoints, some faster than others. Noor watched the timers closely, noting each completion with careful attention. Ivo finished ahead of Kira. Kira adjusted her robot's wheels after a minor collision, hoping to improve its balance for the next round. Nell finished ahead of Kira. Nell is younger than Leo but older than Kira, and Ivo stands taller than both Nell and Noor. Leo, who is the oldest participant, spent part of the afternoon helping newer members solder wires safely. Noor's robot was painted bright yellow, easy to spot among the others on the table. Kira's design used fewer parts than Ivo's, though both worked equally well in the trials. As the day wound down, everyone gathered to compare notes and photograph their creations before packing up the equipment for the evening.
